prompt:

The frames in order: the ring rotated one sixth of a turn per frame with one muzzle flashing amber in turn so the volley loops. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical silhouette and palette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 The rotation is clearly visible: in cell one the four muzzles point straight up, down, left and right; in each following cell the whole ring with its muzzles and spokes is turned a further fifteen degrees clockwise, so by cell four the muzzles point diagonally; and a different muzzle flashes amber in each cell.
